name: Animation Pack (example plugin)
author: The Kinoklip contributors
description: A preset pack: animations and effect stacks you apply to selected clips from the Effects library (drag one onto a clip, or double-click it). A template for packs in the style of animation panels.

presets.name: Fade In
presets.description: Opacity from 0 to 100 % over the first second

presets.name: Fade Out
presets.description: Opacity from 100 to 0 % over the last second

presets.name: Pop In
presets.description: Grows from 80 % to 100 % while it fades in

presets.name: Soft Glow Look
presets.description: A blur and a glow effect on the clip (an effect stack)
